name: search-messages
description: Searches and finds Outlook emails (messages) in the mailbox by words, sender, unread status or folder, newest first when no words are given. Message ids feed microsoft-outlook__reply-to-message, microsoft-outlook__move-message and microsoft-outlook__delete-message; folder ids come from microsoft-outlook__list-mail-folders.

query.description: Free text or Outlook KQL, such as from:, subject:, or hasAttachments:true.

folder.description: Mail folder ID or well-known name such as inbox, sentitems, drafts, or archive.

top.description: Maximum number of messages to request. Defaults to 10.
